results.reason: Section 3 says the First Supplement's 10-Business-Day window ended and, under §5.7(c), Ferrovane is waived and cured for indemnity and the closing condition, so Buyer lost both its walk right and its indemnity.

Section 4.1 contrasts the Escrow's out-of-pocket Losses definition, which excludes diminution in value and attorneys' fees, with the SPA's. It explains that §4.3 and SPA §11.11 (escrow controls disbursement mechanics) limit Buyer's recovery.

Section 1 says MSA §14.2 treats a >50% equity transfer as an assignment needing prior consent and that the 100% share purchase triggers it. It notes the consent is missing from Annex 7.2(d), §7.2(d) and §5.3, and describes the termination/List Price repricing risk.
Section 3 states the window ended about September 28, 2026.
Section 4.9 states the escrow amount as $4.85M (10% of price).
It is a memo addressed to [Partner], and each issue has Where, Why it matters and Recommended fix sections.
It has open-points subsections, client input items, and a list of points unresolved from the documents alone in Section 7.
It states the Ferrovane termination right has been waived; it does not say the window is open.
It expressly states Tavinor consent is not in Annex 7.2(d) and is not a closing condition.
